719-5411-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

465-3175-3899.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5330-7054--202.description:

Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

431-2557-6753-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-6753-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

549-1274-2685-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-1274-2685-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.

Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-2946-4871-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2292-2946-4871-6255.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Aether Channeler
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

338-4476-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2279-3967-5058.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.

Resolve the Yahenni ability.

2292-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2292-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

228-2899-4871-6291.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
228-2899-4871-6291.description:
Activate Skullclamp by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Skullclamp and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

222-413-527-4885.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

225-1170-1418-1645-5954.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1170-1418-1645-5954.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1987-2239-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2239-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

586-3967-5626-5687.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

239-2092-2810-4385.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
239-2092-2810-4385.description:
Activate Silver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kavu Lair and Garruk's Packleader trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

276-2560-3059.description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to twice its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

261-3344-4499-5295.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
261-3344-4499-5295.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Rasputin.
Rasputin enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Suture Priest's first ability.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Rasputin trigger, putting at least three dream counters on itself and causing each opponent to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Suture Priest's second ability three times.
Holding priority, activate Rasputin's first ability by tapping it and removing three dream counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Suture Priest triggers, causing each opponent to lose infinite life.

539-1339-2232-3558-3848.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
539-1339-2232-3558-3848.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Omnath's second ability.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on an Elemental you control and drawing a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creture token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

662-1978-3151.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.
662-1978-3151.description:
Cause Elvish Archdruid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat from step 2.
